cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Try a grape before we buy the bunch. Last week's were sour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Just one. I'll try the next if nobody objects.

beats.text: Fine, but you're holding the bunch where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll hold it out like samples. You take the first one; if that works, I'll serve myself.
